subject: Post-call: Audit log exportability & next steps

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-09T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: Audit log exportability & next steps

Hi Olivia / DevOps team,

Thanks for taking the time today — good discussion. Quick recap and the specific items we agreed to follow up on related to audit logging and compliance: 

1) SOC 2 / Compliance status
   - Current: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report in place (rolling 12-month window) and we maintain SOC artifacts; Naomi (legal/compliance) will provide the latest attestation and scope.

2) GDPR / HIPAA concerns
   - Redwood supports data processing agreements and can sign a BAA where required. For GDPR we offer regional routing and data residency options. Naomi will coordinate DPA/BAA questions.

3) Audit logs & exportability (technical items you asked about)
   - Admin activity logs: full record of console actions (user, time, IP, action, resource).
   - API request logs: incoming request metadata and response status (no payload unless requested).
   - Export methods: S3 export (push), signed HTTPS pull, and syslog forwarding to a customer collector.
   - Retention and immutability: default retention 90 days; can be extended per contract. We support write-once S3 buckets and signed checksums for exported batches to meet tamper-evidence requirements — Naomi will add legal language.

Attachments: vendor_security_questionnaire_v1.pdf (your questionnaire stub) and redwood_auditlog_schema_sample.csv (example export schema).

Next steps we proposed on the call:
- Rishi: circulate the questionnaire + sample schema (attached) and confirm export delivery options by end of day Thursday.
- Naomi: start vendor security questionnaire and return answers within 3 business days.
- Schedule follow-up to review the questionnaire and walk the DevOps team through a sample export (propose Wed 2026-05-13 09:00 PST).

Please confirm those next steps and call out any priority items you want us to address first.

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

Rishi — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- HIPAA: we are subject to HIPAA for a subset of our product telemetry; can you confirm whether the API request logs could be configured to redact PII in transit or excluded entirely from exported payloads?
- Immutability: our procurement team needs a plain-English statement of how you achieve "tamper-evidence" and whether we can get a signed attestation for export jobs.
- Retention: can you propose tiers (90/365/indefinite) and pricing impact?

We have attached our procurement security questionnaire (we'll also upload to your Drive link if you prefer). Procurement timeline: we need vendor responses within 10 business days to hit an internal July procurement window.

I'll confirm the proposed follow-up time once I check with DevOps.

Best,

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-09T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: technical details re: audit log exportability

Quick internal note to seed Naomi's questionnaire responses and to prep the demo: 

- Export formats: CSV/JSON for batch exports; optional gzipped bundles for retention exports. The sample schema (attached) shows fields we can expose.
- Immutability approach: we use S3 write-once lifecycle + signed SHA256 manifest for each batch. For in-platform admin logs we keep an append-only store with immutability markers and hourly hash chains; can provide a summarized attestation.
- PII redaction: redaction at export time is supported via configurable field masks; default is to exclude payloads unless the customer explicitly requests them for debugging (then DPA/BAA controls apply).
- Delivery: push-to-customer-S3 with role-based access is the most common; we can also provide a presigned pull for on-demand exports.

I'll draft the technical answers for the questionnaire and hand to Naomi — will flag anything that needs legal wording.

— Monica (SE)
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-05-10T08:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Audit log exportability & next steps

Hi Olivia — answering your bullets below and booking next steps.

- HIPAA / PII redaction: We can exclude request/response payloads from exports by default. For cases where payloads are needed for debugging, we provide a masked export option that strips common PII fields (names, emails, SSNs) and can apply custom masks on fields you specify. Naomi will add the BAA language for payload handling.

- Tamper-evidence attestation: We will provide a signed attestation for exported batches that includes the SHA256 manifest and timestamped delivery record. For in-platform logs we can provide an export of the hash chain summary covering a requested time window.

- Retention tiers & pricing: baseline 90 days included in hosted plans; 365-day and custom retention are available as add-ons. Monica will follow up with a short cost delta matrix.

Next steps and timing: 
- Naomi (legal) will start the vendor questionnaire today; target: return completed PDF in 3 business days (by 2026-05-13 EOD).
- Technical demo (sample export walk-through): propose Wed 2026-05-13 09:00 PST. I created a HubSpot record for tracking (HS-76432).

Links / attachments: vendor_security_questionnaire_v1.pdf (attached) and redwood_auditlog_schema_sample.csv (attached). Also linking the draft export spec: https://redwood.example.com/drive/medtech-audit-specs

If that timeline works I'll lock the calendar invite.

Thanks,
Rishi
